ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 80% high-intensity white pixels and 20% low-intensity black pixels localized primarily at the margins and central insertion point.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupying the central area of both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a continuous band along the trailing edge and a significant triangular cluster at the central base (peduncle junction). Isolated black focal spots are visible on the distal segments of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate pixel angle of 95 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serration along the trailing edge with low-frequency, medium-amplitude variations; notable jagged peaks near the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edges tapering to acute distal tips; trailing edge displays a slight concavity between the tip and the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the medial-ventral surface of the left lobe; multiple smaller unaligned scratches on the central-ventral surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent dark linear abrasions consistent with rake marks on the inner lobes; irregular trailing edge profile suggesting minor tissue loss or persistent scarring on the distal margin of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique branching black pigment pattern extending from the peduncle base into the lower white field of the fluke lobes.
